metric_definitions.response_ms: proc_exit - matching full Fusion output_pub proxy, native RAW
metric_definitions.deadline_ms: next actual Fusion output_pub - current Fusion output_pub, analyst-selected update boundary
metric_definitions.slack_ms: next actual Fusion output_pub - proc_exit; negative means miss; equality meets
metric_definitions.output_pub: writer entry proxy; not writer return or actual consumer receipt
metric_definitions.output_interval_ms: next writer_done - current writer_done, RAW; next event must also be window-complete for window statistics
metric_definitions.stability_span_ms: max(output intervals)-min(output intervals) over 20 consecutive intervals; no formal I or theta; a constant I cancels in the span
metric_definitions.sleeping_ms: interruptible S or idle I; excludes D
metric_definitions.uninterruptible_ms: D and D flags; disjoint from sleeping
metric_definitions.unknown_ms: event gaps, unmapped TID, open states or unsupported states
metric_definitions.running_ms: CPU residency, not proof of useful computation
metric_definitions.queue_wait_ms: unavailable exact point; lower/upper bounds retained separately

evidence_scale.E3: closed causal chain or controlled intervention
evidence_scale.E4: not defined in workspace scale; never emitted
